title.zh: v0.9.2：0.9.0 的完整说明，附公告面板修复
title.en: v0.9.2: the full 0.9.0 notes, plus a changelog fix

body.zh:
这一版把 0.9.0 的功能说明完整带上：编辑器实时渲染、独立笔记窗口、从资源管理器打开 .md。

同时修掉一个公告面板的问题：关闭后再打开，正文会停留在加载占位条上不显示。

更新入口在标题栏右上角、公告喇叭右侧，只在有新版本时出现：第一次点击下载，第二次点击重启安装。
body.en:
This release carries the full 0.9.0 notes: live-rendered editing, standalone note windows, and opening .md files from Explorer.

It also fixes the announcement board: after closing and reopening it, the body text stayed on the loading placeholder.

The update entry sits at the top right of the title bar, right of the announcement button. It appears only when a new version exists: first click downloads, second click restarts into the installer.

body.zh:
这一版是维护更新，集中修复已知问题，没有新增功能。

已经在 0.9.0 上的用户可以直接在软件内更新；0.8.1 及更早的版本会先收到升级提示，点一下即可完成。
body.en:
A maintenance release: known issues fixed, no new features.

Users already on 0.9.0 can update inside the app. Versions 0.8.1 and earlier will be offered the upgrade first and can finish it in one click.

title.zh: v0.9.0：实时渲染、独立窗口与新更新入口
title.en: v0.9.0: live rendering, note windows, new update entry

body.zh:
编辑器改成边写边看：粗体、斜体、链接等标记在光标离开后就地隐藏，标题分级、表格真正渲染，代码块接入 14 门语言高亮。正在编辑的那一段会显示原始 Markdown，移开即恢复排版。

笔记可以放进独立窗口：工具栏的窗口图标，或「文件 → 在独立窗口中打开」，与主窗口双向同步。安装版还会把「Qing Notepad」写进 .md 的右键「打开方式」，不抢默认程序。

**更新入口搬到标题栏**：启动时的更新弹窗已下线。有新版本时，标题栏右上角、公告喇叭右侧会出现一个下载图标；第一次点击下载，第二次点击重启安装。平时不显示，忽略只对本次运行有效。
body.en:
The editor now renders as you type: bold, italic and link markers hide once the cursor leaves them, headings get real type scale, tables render, and code blocks get syntax highlighting for 14 languages. The block you are editing stays as raw Markdown and snaps back when you move away.

Notes can open in their own window from the editor toolbar or File > Open in window, with two-way sync to the main window. Installed builds also register Qing Notepad under Open with for .md files without taking over the default app.

The update entry moved to the title bar: the startup dialog is gone. When a new version exists, a download icon appears at the top right, just right of the announcement button. First click downloads, second click restarts into the installer. It stays hidden otherwise, and ignore only lasts for this run.

title.zh: v0.8.1：更新改成在软件里完成
title.en: v0.8.1: updates happen inside the app

body.zh:
「检查更新」不再是跳到网页让你自己下安装包：发现新版本后点一下按钮，就在软件内下载并安装，装完自动重启到新版本。默认从 Gitee 取更新，连不上时才回落到 GitHub。

但这一版仍然需要手动安装一次。0.8.0 及以前的版本里没有更新代码，收不到下一条推送；装完 0.8.1 之后，往后的版本才会变成点一下就好。

安装包会做签名校验：签名对不上就拒绝安装，被替换过的安装包不会悄悄装进来。
body.en:
"Check for updates" no longer sends you to a web page: when a new version appears, one click downloads and installs it in the app, then restarts on the new version. Updates come from Gitee by default and fall back to GitHub only when Gitee is unreachable.

This version still has to be installed manually once. Versions up to 0.8.0 ship no update code, so they will never see the next prompt; after 0.8.1 is installed, every later version is a single click.

Installers are signature-checked: a package that fails verification is refused, so a swapped installer can never be installed quietly.

title.zh: v0.8.0：插件扩展、知识图谱与新界面
title.en: v0.8.0: extensions, knowledge graph, new surfaces

body.zh:
这一版可以装插件了：插件命令会出现在命令面板里，权限逐条确认，装坏了可以回滚到上一版本，随包还带 8 个示例插件。插件在独立 Worker 里运行，拿不到系统能力，没授权的权限不会执行。

新增知识图谱：把任意文件夹加为只读资料库，笔记与文件在同一张图里查看，能看到反链、断链和孤立节点，选中节点可直接跳回编辑器。

界面一并收敛：画布工具栏改成居中悬浮胶囊，扩展页、图谱浮层与画布统一为工作台的卡片样式，图谱画布改为透明底，直接透出磨砂与壁纸。
body.en:
This release can install extensions: their commands show up in the command palette, permissions are granted one by one, a bad install can be rolled back, and eight examples ship with the app. Extensions run in their own worker with no system access, so an ungranted permission never executes.

Knowledge graph is new: add any folder as a read-only library, see notes and files on one canvas, follow backlinks, broken links and orphans, then jump back to the editor from a node.

The interface is unified too: the canvas toolbar is a floating pill, the extensions page, graph overlay and canvas share the workspace card language, and the graph canvas is transparent so the frosted glass shows through.

title.zh: v0.7.3：磨砂修复与对比度整改
title.en: v0.7.3: glass fix and contrast pass

body.zh:
修复 v0.7.2 引入的磨砂回归：安装包里模糊完全不生效的问题已解决，模糊强度与饱和度恢复正常。没有背景图时磨砂滑块也能看出变化，主卡不透明度重新按侧栏派生。

全站正文对比度整改完成，四个主题下正文与弱化文字均达到 4.5:1。AI 会话改为按接口隔离，切换接口不再串会话。
body.en:
Fixed the frosted-glass regression from v0.7.2: blur works again in installed builds, with strength and saturation back to normal. The glass sliders now visibly change without a wallpaper, because the main card's opacity is derived from the sidebar again.

Body-text contrast was reworked across all four themes, so body and muted text now clear 4.5:1. AI conversations are isolated per endpoint, so switching endpoints no longer mixes sessions.
